emails.subject: REFUND OR I EXPOSE YOU
emails.label: buyer
emails.body:
You sold me 500 cards and half of them were dead or duplicates I already had. This is NOT what was advertised.

I paid 0.08 BTC for this trash. You have 48 hours to either refund my wallet or send me clean replacement data — full CC + SSN sets, no duplicates.

If I don't hear from you I am posting your alias, your proton address, AND your BTC wallet to every forum I can find. I have screenshots of every transaction.

Don't test me. I've done it before.

emails.subject: I know what you did
emails.label: threat
emails.body:
I don't know who you are, but I know what you did.

My credit card information, my SSN, my medical records — all of it turned up on a dark web forum. My bank traced the breach back to my email provider last October. I hired a cybersecurity consultant to help me trace it further and they found a trail that ended at this email address.

I have already filed a report with the FBI Cyber Division. They are actively investigating. But trust me. If they don't get you, I FUCKING will.

You think you are anonymous, but you are not as invisible as you believe.

If you have any sense of self-preservation, you will stop whatever you are doing. This does not end well for you.

— R. Harrington
